sentences.ar: كان الدم بينزل على إيدي، وكنت خايف كتير.
sentences.en: The blood was running down my arm, and I was very afraid.

sentences.ar: بس لما شديت، فهمت إن السكين ماسكة جلدي بس.
sentences.en: But when I pulled, I understood the knife was holding only my skin.

sentences.ar: وشديت مرة وحدة، وتحررت، والألم كان أقل من الخوف.
sentences.en: And I pulled once, and was free, and the pain was less than the fear.
I went down to the cabin, and dressed my wound myself.

sentences.ar: ورميت الميت التاني بالبحر، ورا هاندز.
sentences.en: And I threw the other dead man into the sea, after Hands.
And the ship was mine, mine alone.

sentences.ar: كانت الشمس عم تغيب، والسفينة مايلة عالرمل، بس سليمة.
sentences.en: The sun was setting, and the ship lay heeled on the sand, but whole.

sentences.ar: نزلت بالمي لحد الخصر، ووصلت عالشط.
sentences.en: I went down into the water up to my waist, and reached the shore.

sentences.ar: وقلت: هلق برجع للقلعة، وبقول لهم: السفينة إلنا.
sentences.en: And I said: now I go back to the stockade, and tell them: the ship is ours.
And perhaps they forgive me for running away.
And I walked through the island in the dark, for hours.

sentences.ar: والقمر طلع، وشفت القلعة، وما كان فيها نار.
sentences.en: And the moon rose, and I saw the stockade, and there was no fire in it.
I said: they are asleep.

sentences.ar: وهاد غلط، الكابتن ما بيترك بلا حراسة.
sentences.en: And that is wrong; the captain never leaves it unguarded.

sentences.ar: تسلقت السور، وزحفت للبيت، وفت من الباب على إيدي وركبي.
sentences.en: I climbed the fence, crawled to the house, and went in the door on hands and knees.
There were people asleep, snoring.
And I said: I will surprise them, and they will laugh.
And in that moment, a sharp voice screeched in the dark:
Pieces of eight!
Pieces of eight!
Pieces of eight!
Silver's parrot.
Everyone got up at once.

sentences.ar: وسمعت صوت سيلفر يصرخ: مين هناك؟
sentences.en: And I heard Silver's voice shout: who is there?
I ran for the door, and fell into the arms of a man.
He held me, and another struck a light.
And I saw: the stockade was full of pirates.

sentences.ar: ستة رجال، وسيلفر بالنص، على عكازه.
sentences.en: Six men, and Silver in the middle, on his crutch.
And not one of my friends.
Silver said: Jim Hawkins!
Well, well!
Come to visit us.
